dimensions.assessment: Directly affects Grand County, Utah, the Grand County Water Conservancy District, and local communities experiencing water deficits.
dimensions.evidence: provide for the transfer of the Moab site to Grand County, Utah

dimensions.assessment: Transfers ownership of a remediated industrial/radioactive site and associated water infrastructure and rights to local entities.
dimensions.evidence: Secretary of Energy shall convey, at no cost, all available right, title, and interest of the United States in and to the Moab site to Grand County, Utah.

dimensions.assessment: Involves transfer of federal property and infrastructure at no cost, with water rights retained as necessary for ongoing groundwater remediation.
dimensions.evidence: convey, at no cost, to the Grand County Water Conservancy District all right, title, and interest of the United States

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Strom Thurmond National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 1999 to authorize specific property and water rights transfers.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Strom Thurmond National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 1999 to provide for the transfer of the Moab site to Grand County

dimensions.assessment: Permanent property ownership transfer and long-term restrictions on land and infrastructure reconveyance.
dimensions.evidence: prohibits Grand County, Utah, from reconveying to a private entity or nonprofit organization any portion of the land

importance_detail.rationale: The bill authorizes the Department of Energy to convey the Moab uranium mill tailings site and associated water infrastructure to Grand County and the local water conservancy district upon remediation completion.
